name: Manganic-Campanile
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past massive canyon systems, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
